meta.skip_reason: Services offline — backend and frontend not running; static-only audit

escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing — authorization bypass
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends X-Forwarded-For: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 to spoof localhost IP, bypassing IP-based access controls and rate limiting
escalations.fix: Upgrade to express >=5.0.0 which pulls proxy-addr >=2.0.8

escalations.title: Handlebars AST injection → Remote Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a Handlebars template with malformed @partial-block reference, injecting JavaScript that executes with backend process privileges

escalations.title: vitest Arbitrary File Read + Code Execution via UI server
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker on same network as dev server requests /mock?path=../../etc/passwd via vitest UI; reads sensitive files or injects malicious mocks executed on next test run
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=5.0.0 (major version bump required)

escalations.title: Vite dev server path traversal — sensitive file disclosure
escalations.exploit_scenario: If project path overlaps with system paths, attacker requests files outside server.fs.allow boundary, disclosing /etc/passwd or CI secrets

escalations.title: portal/Backend — 4 critical CVEs (jest ecosystem + proxy-addr)
escalations.exploit_scenario: jest ecosystem code injection via malformed error stacks + proxy-addr IP spoofing (same as DEP-001, second project surface)
escalations.fix: Upgrade jest to >=30.5.2; upgrade to express >=5.0.0 for proxy-addr fix

escalations.title: portal/Frontend — vitest + vite critical CVEs
escalations.exploit_scenario: Same as DEP-003 and DEP-004 but affecting the portal/Frontend project surface
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=5.0.0; npm update vite to >=8.3.5

p1_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md has ~85 FR rows with 0% implementation
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Traceability enforcer reports green while covering only 13% of spec surface; entire requirement set silently untracked
p1_findings.recommendation: Mark dev-workflow-platform.md as 'deferred/future' with explicit status header, OR exclude it from inspector.config.yml specs.dir scope

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer silently targets only the most-recently-modified plan
p2_findings.recommendation: Pin enforcer to a canonical requirements file in inspector.config.yml or pass --plan explicitly in CLAUDE.md verification gate

p2_findings.title: inspector.config traceability regex 'FR-\d+' doesn't match code format 'FR-WF-\d+'
p2_findings.recommendation: Update specs.patterns.traceability to 'FR-(WF-\d+|dependency[a-z-]*)' to match actual codebase format

p2_findings.title: Route handlers import store directly, bypassing the service layer
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract CRUD logic into services/workItemService.ts and services/intakeService.ts; route handlers should only parse request/response

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing not implemented despite CLAUDE.md mandate
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations; create tracing.ts initializer; add custom spans to routeWorkItem, runAssessmentPod, dispatchWorkItem

p2_findings.title: jest ecosystem — 33+ HIGH CVEs (code injection, ReDoS, prototype pollution)
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade jest to >=30.5.2 across all projects

p2_findings.title: js-yaml ReDoS via deeply nested YAML merge keys
micromatch/braces ReDoS via unbalanced brace expressions

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Keep pages/ versions (more complete), delete root-level duplicates

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions on react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 production files
p3_findings.recommendation: Fix hooks to include all dependencies, or add explanatory comment for intentional suppression

p4_findings.title: DebugPortalPage.tsx has no FR linkage or test coverage
